verdict.rationale: In the terminal, the CLI lets you pause a running agent with Esc and resume previous conversations, so you can interrupt and redirect a task there. Conversation goals offer stop/resume controls, and Agent Canvas is described as a browser control center for agent conversations. However, nothing shows a developer taking direct hands-on control of the agent's workspace to finish the work themselves, and no editor/IDE handoff is evidenced. missing for 10: editor/IDE takeover of an in-progress task, explicit hands-on workspace handoff (e.g., opening the agent's sandbox to edit directly), detail on mid-task redirection in the browser UI, independent corroboration.
